scripts.build:watcher: python -m PyInstaller --onefile --noconsole --name watcher-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --distpath src-tauri/binaries --workpath build/pyinstaller-work --specpath build/pyinstaller-work --collect-submodules scapy.layers --hidden-import diagnose scripts/watcher.py
scripts.dist: npm run build:watcher && tauri build && node scripts/copy-release.mjs release/win-unpacked
scripts.dist:dev: npm run build:watcher && tauri build --features devtools --config src-tauri/tauri.devbuild.conf.json && node scripts/copy-release.mjs release-dev/win-unpacked
